verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a workflow builder that triggers automated actions on events (e.g., Slack alerts on Zendesk tickets, reminders for bonuses, auto provisioning/deprovisioning, rule-based permission enforcement), showing genuine event-driven rule automation. However, there's no evidence of an AI-native interface for authoring these rules (e.g., natural language rule creation), so it's more traditional workflow automation than AI-native rule definition.
